PS5 Mobile v3.0 · Ultra Optimize Engine

PS5 Mobile v3.0 is a native Android WebGPU host & controller shell for playgta5.com (Emscripten WASM + DirectX 11 -> WebGPU).

⚡ ULTRA OPTIMIZE MODE forces GTA V onto low-VRAM and low-RAM Android phones via:
• BC1–BC7 Texture Mip-Drop (caps decoded RGBA textures to ≤256px or ≤128px, cutting texture VRAM by 75%–88%)
• 360p / 270p GBuffer scaling (cuts ~12 deferred render targets by 4x–7x)
• Uniform ring (8MB -> 1–2MB), buffer arena (16MB -> 4MB), BindGroup cache (24K -> 1.5K–3K) & proxy-texture leak fix
• IO worker RAM cap (192–768MB -> 16–32MB) + live Android onTrimMemory cache flush
• Direct Boot skips PS5 Home WebView to preserve ~150MB extra RAM
